Rally

Rally is a platform that allows the buying and selling of equity shares in collectible assets within the financial services industry. The company sources, verifies, and acquires notable items, transforms them into equity shares, and offers these shares to investors through an Initial Offering, followed by a trading platform for buying and selling shares. It was founded in 2016 and is based in New York, New York.

Portion

Portion is an auction house focused on NFT art, music, and collectibles within the digital asset domain. The company offers a platform for transactions involving art and collectibles with verified authenticity and provenance using blockchain technology. Portion serves the digital art and collectibles market. It was founded in 2016 and is based in New York, New York.

Timeless Medical Systems

Timeless Medical Systems focuses on clinical nutrition management and provides software solutions for the management and administration of maternal breast milk, human donor milk, and infant formula, as well as nutritional supplements. It was founded in 1995 and is based in Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island.
